arxiv-2204-11379.title: Theory of QED radiative corrections to neutrino scattering at accelerator energies
arxiv-2204-11379.creator: Oleksandr Tomalak, Qing Chen, Richard J. Hill, Kevin S. McFarland, Clarence Wret
arxiv-2204-11379.description: Abstract Control over quantum electrodynamics (QED) radiative corrections is critical for precise determination of neutrino oscillation probabilities from observed (anti)neutrino detection rates. It is particularly important to understand any difference between such corrections for different flavors of (anti)neutrinos in charged-current interactions. We provide theoretical foundations for calculating these corrections.

arxiv-2310-16754.title: CAD - Contextual Multi-modal Alignment for Dynamic AVQA
arxiv-2310-16754.creator: Asmar Nadeem, Adrian Hilton, Robert Dawes, Graham Thomas, Armin Mustafa
arxiv-2310-16754.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Asmar Nadeem, Adrian Hilton, Robert Dawes, Graham Thomas, Armin Mustafa. In the context of Audio Visual Question Answering (AVQA) tasks, the audio visual modalities could be learnt on three levels: 1) Spatial, 2) Temporal, and 3) Semantic. Existing AVQA methods suffer from two major shortcomings; the audio-visual (AV) information passing through the network isn’t aligned on Spatial and Temporal levels; and, inter-modal (audio and visual) Semantic information is often not balanced within a context; this results in poor performance.

arxiv-2410-21768.title: Broadband Optoelectronic Mixer for Terahertz Frequency-Comb Measurements Journal: opticajournal
arxiv-2410-21768.creator: Jizhao Zang, Jesse S. Morgan, Andreas Beling, Scott B. Papp
arxiv-2410-21768.description: Abstract We demonstrate ultra-broadband optoelectronic mixing of frequency combs that provides phase-coherent detection of a repetition frequency up to 500 GHz, using a high-speed modified uni-traveling carrier (MUTC) photodiode. Nonlinear photo-electron effects in the photodiode itself enable harmonic generation and down-mixing process of combs with widely different repetition frequency.

arxiv-2502-02503.title: Near-Feasible Solutions to Complex Stable Matching Problems
arxiv-2502-02503.creator: Gergely Csáji (HUN-REN KRTK)
arxiv-2502-02503.description: Abstract . In this paper, we demonstrate that in many NP-complete variants of the stable matching problem, such as the Stable Hypergraph Matching problem, the College Admission problem with Common Quotas and the Stable Multicommodity Flow problem, a near-feasible stable solution – that is, a solution which is stable, but may slightly violate some capacities – always exists.

arxiv-2503-24191.title: When Grammar Guides the Attack: Uncovering Control-Plane Vulnerabilities in LLMs with Structured Output
arxiv-2503-24191.creator: Shuoming Zhang, Jiacheng Zhao, Hanyuan Dong, Ruiyuan Xu, Zhicheng Li, Yangyu Zhang, Shuaijiang Li, Yuan Wen, Chunwei Xia, Zheng Wang, Xiaobing Feng, Huimin Cui
arxiv-2503-24191.description: Abstract . Content Warning: This paper may contain unsafe or harmful content generated by LLMs that may be offensive to readers. Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly serve as tooling platforms through structured output APIs, but the grammar-guided decoding that powers this feature opens a critical control-plane attack surface orthogonal to traditional data-plane vulnerabilities.

arxiv-2507-08870.title: GUIDE: Towards Scalable Advising for Research Ideas
arxiv-2507-08870.creator: Yaowenqi Liu, BingXu Meng, Rui Pan, Jerry Huang, Tong ZhangUniversity of Illinois Urbana-Champaign {yl140, bingxum2, ruip4, jerry8, tozhang}@illinois.edu
arxiv-2507-08870.description: Abstract The field of AI research is advancing at an unprecedented pace, enabling automated hypothesis generation and experimental design across diverse domains such as biology, mathematics, and artificial intelligence. Despite these advancements, there remains a significant gap in the availability of scalable advising systems capable of providing high-quality, well-reasoned feedback to refine proposed hypotheses and experimental designs.

arxiv-2601-19244.title: Physics-Informed Neuro-Symbolic Recommender System: A Dual-Physics Approach for Personalized Nutrition
arxiv-2601-19244.creator: Chayan Banerjee
arxiv-2601-19244.description: Abstract Traditional e-commerce recommender systems primarily optimize for user engagement and purchase likelihood, often neglecting the rigid physiological constraints required for human health. Standard collaborative filtering algorithms are structurally blind to these hard limits, frequently suggesting bundles that fail to meet specific total daily energy expenditure and macronutrient balance requirements.

pmc-12435117.title: Unerwünschte Wirkungen von Januskinase‐Inhibitoren mit Relevanz für den dermatologischen Klinik‐ und Praxisalltag
pmc-12435117.creator: Anika Rajput Khokhar, Kamran Ghoreschi, Julia Huynh
pmc-12435117.description: ZusammenfassungSeit 2011 in den USA und 2012 in der EU eingesetzt, etablieren sich Januskinase‐Inhibitoren (JAKi) zunehmend in der Therapie dermatologischer Erkrankungen wie atopische Dermatitis, Psoriasis, Psoriasis‐Arthritis, Alopecia areata, chronisches Handekzem und Vitiligo. pmc-12837010.title: Cost-effectiveness of short-term parent-infant-psychotherapy, results from two randomized controlled trials
pmc-12837010.creator: Benjamin Kaß, Anne Berghöfer, Lars Kuchinke, Christiane Ludwig-Koerner, Franziska Schlensog-Schuster, Stephanie Roll, Thomas Keil, Thomas Reinhold
pmc-12837010.description: BackgroundMaternal sensitivity is a crucial factor in fostering infants’ resilience and healthy development. Parent-Infant Psychotherapy (PIP) interventions focus on the improvement of maternal or paternal sensitivity, among other outcomes. Little is known about their cost-effectiveness. This study aimed to evaluate the cost-effectiveness of a short-term PIP compared to care as usual (CAU) in Germany.

pmc-13279420.title: Efficacy of hyaluronic acid and butyroyl glutathione in the management of glaucoma-related ocular surface disease: a prospective, interventional, double-blind, cross-over post market study
pmc-13279420.creator: Gabriele Gallo Afflitto, Marialaura Fanelli, Vita Petrone, Rossella Chirico, Francesca Ceccarelli, Alessio Martucci, Antonella Minutolo, Francesco Aiello, Enrico Garaci, Claudia Matteucci, Carlo Nucci
pmc-13279420.description: IntroductionTo evaluate the efficacy of a novel eye drop formulation containing hyaluronic acid (0.2%) and butyroyl-glutathione (GSHC4, 0.4%) in glaucoma-associated ocular surface disease (G-OSD), and to explore putative mechanisms of action through in vitro assays of corneal epithelial wound healing and cytokine modulation under basal, inflammatory, and oxidative stress conditions.

pmc-13344041.title: ClpX-dependent regulatory pathway exacerbates Streptococcus pyogenes pathogenesis in diabetic skin infection
pmc-13344041.creator: Shuiqiao Liu, Anne L. Rosen, Benjamin S. Olson, Yongke Lu, Suzanne Hickerson, Andrew L. Kau, Scott J. Hultgren, Michael G. Caparon, Wei Xu
pmc-13344041.description: Diabetes is associated with impaired immune function and increased susceptibility to severe bacterial infections, yet the pathogen-encoded mechanisms that exacerbate disease in this context remain poorly defined. Streptococcus pyogenes (group A Streptococcus [GAS]) causes invasive skin and soft tissue infections that are disproportionately severe in individuals with diabetes, often accompanied by delayed healing, excessive inflammation, and polymicrobial overgrowth.

pmc-13679969.title: Factors associated with early death from de novo metastatic breast cancer in Ontario, Canada
pmc-13679969.creator: Priya Thomas, Brooke Carter, Craig C Earle, Salimah Z Shariff, Jacques Raphael, Alyson Mahar, Sarah Knowles, Muriel Brackstone, Michael Lock, Andrea Eisen, Areej Hezam, Phillip S Blanchette
pmc-13679969.description: Background:Early death from female breast cancer is influenced by disease biology and factors such as age, marginalization, socioeconomic status, rurality, and access to primary care. Our objective was to investigate factors associated with early death in the subgroup of patients diagnosed with advanced de novo metastatic breast cancer, defined by the presence of distant metastatic disease at initial presentation.

pmc-13684576.title: A Microglial Regulatory Program Linked to Neuropsychiatric Disorders
pmc-13684576.creator: Dimitri Traenkner, Alyssa P. Johnson, Megan E. Williams, Adrian Rothenfluh
pmc-13684576.description: Hoxb8 is a transcription factor required for the normal function of a specialized microglial population. Loss of Hoxb8 causes compulsive overgrooming and anxiety-like behaviors in mice, with greater severity in females after sexual maturity. However, the Hoxb8-dependent transcriptional program in microglia remains poorly understood.
